Package com.ucm.server.players

Class ClassifierFSM

java.lang.Object
com.ucm.server.gameobjects.Bot
com.ucm.server.gameobjects.BotFSM
com.ucm.server.players.ClassifierFSM
All Implemented Interfaces:
IPlayerNotificator
public class ClassifierFSM extends BotFSM
This class represents a bot that uses a finite state machine (FSM) to decide its next move in a poker game. The bot evaluates the total value of the cards on the table and in its hand to determine its action, which can be folding, calling/checking, raising, or going all-in.
